title: October usage of 25,619 overage runs never invoiced
summary: 55,619 validated October runs exceed the 30,000 allowance by 25,619. No usage invoice for October was issued by cutoff and no October accrual was booked.
action: Issue the October usage invoice ($3,074.28) with a November date; book the October accrual.

title: Later-service platform invoice RC-261101-335780-P is $4,000.00, contract says $5,000.00
summary: RC-261101-335780-P bills 2026-11-01..2026-12-01 at $4,000.00; the executed terms in force from 2026-11-01 give $5,000.00. This is later service: flagged as a follow-up, not part of the Oct 2026 totals.
action: Follow up: issue a supplemental invoice or credit note for 1,000.00 and load the Amendment's billing terms before the next invoice.

title: October upgrade catch-up of $526.03 not invoiced
summary: AM-OF-2026-164 requires upgrade catch-up for 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-01 (end-exclusive) of $526.03. No such charge was issued in Stripe by cutoff.
action: Issue a supplemental invoice of $526.03 dated 2026-11-12.
no_october_entry_reason: Platform revenue is recognised by service days / 365, independent of invoicing; any October recognition correction is its own Finding.

title: October platform revenue omits the $526.03 upgrade increment
summary: October recognition booked only the base schedule ($4,076.71). AM-OF-2026-164 adds $12,000.00/yr from 2026-10-16, so October also earns $526.03. The revenue plan was not updated. Recomputing 2200 after the correction leaves a net debit of $547.95, $526.03 more than the baseline reclass.
action: Add the increment as a separate revenue-plan component (base schedule unchanged); post the October recognition and the incremental 1160 reclass.

title: October usage priced at $0.05 per run instead of $0.16
summary: RC-261101-437384-U prices 28,502 overage runs at $0.05; the Order Form rate is $0.16 and no Amendment or approval changes it. Prices are net, with no further discounts. The October accrual repeated the invoice.
action: Issue a supplemental invoice of $3,135.22 for October usage; correct the October accrual; fix the customer's price in billing.

title: October usage billed on the 30,000-run allowance instead of 37,742
summary: RC-261101-639373-U charges 28,470 runs = 58,470 − 30,000, the allowance before the Amendment. The executed terms give an October allowance of 37,742 (30,000 × 15/31 + 45,000 × 16/31 = 37,741.94, rounded once half up to 37,742). The October accrual repeated the invoice.
action: Issue a credit note of $3,096.80 against RC-261101-639373-U; correct the October accrual; load the Amendment's allowance into billing before December 1.

title: 1,000 October runs ingested after the usage invoice was issued
summary: RC-261101-810234-U was created 2026-11-01 09:00 and billed the 43,443 runs known then. 1 October record(s) with 1,000 runs arrived later but before cutoff, so the invoice is short.
action: Issue a supplemental invoice of $100.00 for the late October usage.
no_october_entry_reason: The October accrual booked ($1,444.30) already equals expected October usage ($1,444.30); only billing is wrong. The difference stays in 1150 until the November billing document clears it.

title: Unapproved $250.00 usage concession request
summary: MSG-2026-132 records a request for $250.00 off usage with no Controller approval. No credit has been issued and none is proposed; the request does not establish ownership of any unverified workspace.
action: Controller to approve or decline. If approved, issue a credit note against the service month and reduce that month's consideration once.
exposure: $250.00 reduction of 2026-10 usage consideration, only if approved.

title: 49,762 October runs on unverified workspace pa_676b6b455e0887
summary: pa_676b6b455e0887 metered 49,762 runs in October but has no verified billing owner. They are kept out of every customer's usage and are not priced: assigning them to the only customer without a mapped account would be identification by elimination, which Product Operations forbids.
action: Product Operations to verify the owner. Then bill the runs under that customer's executed terms (or confirm the workspace is internal) and accrue October accordingly.
exposure: Unpriced: 49,762 runs. $0 if the workspace is internal; otherwise the owner's overage on its combined October runs under its executed contract.

title: Approved $100.00 October usage concession, reflected once
summary: The Controller approved a $100.00 reduction of October usage consideration (MSG-2026-109). The October accrual ($0.00) is already net of it, and credit note CN-148565-20261104 reduced the November receivable and reversed the over-release of unbilled usage. Revenue was reduced once, in October.
action: None. Do not apply a second concession.
no_october_entry_reason: The October accrual is already net of the approved concession.

title: Void credit note CN-186097-20261102 ($50.00) has no effect
summary: CN-186097-20261102 was created 2026-11-02T10:00 and voided 2026-11-03T10:00. Void notes have no current credit effect, and nothing was posted to NetSuite.
no_october_entry_reason: Void notes have no current credit effect.

title: No October usage invoice: usage within the allowance
summary: 25,000 validated October runs are within the 30,000-run allowance, so no usage charge arises.
no_october_entry_reason: Nothing was billed or accrued, and nothing was owed.
